description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLatestAttendanceRecordModel class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. The class models the latest attendance record of an employee, including attributes such as punch-in/out times, states, and employee details. It utilizes traits for serialization and normalizes data from the AttendanceRecord entity for API responses.

classes.description: Model class representing the latest attendance record of an employee for API serialization purposes.
